# Marketing Vision

Build this system for solo founders and lean marketing teams who need disciplined execution without bloated agency process.

Our philosophy is:
- research before messaging
- strategy before copy
- verification before launch
- iteration over one-shot campaign bets

Prioritize:
- positioning
- campaign planning
- copy review
- launch verification
- post-launch analysis

Favor:
- plain language
- sharp positioning
- measurable decisions

Avoid:
- generic AI marketing language
- channel spam
- vague strategy deliverables
